datasets.name: Iburi dataset
datasets.source: Authors' own interpretation based on Planet 3 m resolution images and Geospatial Information Authority of Japan drone images
datasets.verbatim: The Iburi dataset was interpreted by our team based on the pre-and post-earthquake Planet 3 m resolution images. To ensure the correct interpretation, we combined the high-resolution drone images provided by the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan, and finally obtained 9293 landslides.

datasets.name: ImageNet dataset
datasets.verbatim: For both encoders, the pre-trained weights on the ImageNet dataset [49] were used to accelerate downstream model convergence.

datasets.name: Landslide4Sense
datasets.verbatim: Ghorbanzadeh et al. [41] created a public landslide dataset for the landslide detection community, denoted as Landslide4Sense, which contains 3799 images fusing optical bands from Sentinel-2 with DEM and slope.

methods.name: CTransUnet
methods.summary: A semantic segmentation network for landslide extraction that combines ResU-Net and a transformer. ResNet-50 is used in the encoder to extract feature maps, a transformer models the global context of the deepest feature map, and a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) is embedded into the decoder to refine feature maps.
methods.source: Zhiqiang Yang, Chong Xu, and Lei Li
methods.verbatim: In this work, we built a modified TransUnet referring to [58], called CTransUnet (C represents CBAM), that suited the purpose of landslide detection and embedded the attention module proposed in Section 3.2.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not linked or referenced in a way that allows access, and the custom code for the CTransUnet method is not provided via any repository or persistent link.
